findings.failureScenario: Three rustdoc comments in lib.rs are attached to the wrong item: slideshow_tick is documented as 'Show a transient toast at the bottom of the canvas' (a leftover from toast()); the HoverPreview struct is documented as 'Whether the settings render in black & white' (belongs to is_bw, which has no doc); and rules_view carries album_counts' whole description ('Every album's photo count for the sidebar...') while album_counts at line 1811 is undocumented. Generated docs and IDE hovers describe the wrong behaviour for these items.
findings.action: Move each orphaned doc line to its item: the toast line to toast(), the black & white line to is_bw(), and the album-count paragraph to album_counts().

findings.failureScenario: Locale::ALL is documented as 'Every language, in menu order', but the Edit > Language menu is built from LANGUAGE_COMMANDS, whose order differs (French follows Portuguese there; in ALL it follows Russian). The doc claim is false and the two language pickers present different orders.
findings.action: Either reorder one table to match the other (preferably derive LANGUAGE_COMMANDS from ALL) or correct the doc to say ALL is the Settings order.
